examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
7
new 2 10
allow 1 0
allow 1 5
allow 1 9
allow 1 10
allow 1 14
allow 1 15
examples.expected: null true true false true false true
examples.display:
calls   = SlidingLimiter(2, 10), allow(1, 0), allow(1, 5),
          allow(1, 9), allow(1, 10), allow(1, 14),
          allow(1, 15)
results = null, true, true, false, true, false, true

At 10 the request from time 0 has left the window (10 − 10 = 0 is not inside). At 14 the window still holds 5 and 10; at 15 only 10 is left.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
calls   = SlidingLimiter(1, 3), allow(0, 0), allow(1, 0),
          allow(0, 2), allow(0, 3)
results = null, true, true, false, true

User 0 waits until time 3 for the request at 0 to leave the window.

edge.label: Edge 1: refused requests do not count
Edge 2: many at the same time
